coverage.summary: Applies to all rental properties used for dwelling purposes, including mobile homes, except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt.

evidence.quoted_span: except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings
except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings
The law against reprisal applies to all rental properties used for dwelling purposes,
except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings

result.notes: The existing coverage is supported by the DCA Truth in Renting guide's 'Reprisal - Civil Rights of Tenants' section, so no values were changed. The exemption covers owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, so the maximum unit count for the owner-occupied exemption is 3. None of the other documents (D065, D066, D068, D069, DX16) address N.J.S.A. 2A:42-10.10.
